entities.summary: Thomas John Miller is an American lawyer and politician who served as the 33rd Attorney General of Iowa from 1995 until his defeat in 2023. After the defeat of West Virginia Attorney General Darrell McGraw in 2012 when running for reelection, Miller became the longest serving State Attorney General in the United States.
